Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000928": On 2026-01-13, Team Atlas noticed that the ledger's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger)
- memory_id "1000924": On 2026-01-05, Team Cinder observed that the ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Cinder, ledger)
- memory_id "1000920": On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000916": On 2025-12-29, the Ember team observed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Ember team, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000895": On 2025-12-23, Team Atlas noticed that the billing service's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, billing service)
- memory_id "1000887": As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000883": As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000876" [decision]: On 2025-12-17, Team Dune decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write.  (about: Team Dune, indexer)
- memory_id "1000805": As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000715": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000642": On 2025-08-29, Team Atlas observed that the catalog service's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000602" [constraint]: Changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000588": INC-2025-017 was an incident affecting the auth gateway on 2025-07-27.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000514": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000511": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas flagged that the notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, noting the notifier is not their service.  (about: Team Atlas, notifier)
- memory_id "1000345": During INC-2025-011, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000341": Team Atlas flagged on 2025-04-18 that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000232": The ledger relies on the auth gateway for service tokens, so if the auth gateway is down, the ledger service is down.  (about: ledger, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000180": Team Cinder flagged that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
Existing entity names: Team Atlas, ledger, Team Cinder, indexer, Ember team, auth gateway, billing service, Team Boreal, Team Dune, scheduler, catalog service, INC-2025-017, resizer, notifier, INC-2025-011, webhooks service
